title: Divinity Original Sin: The Board Game
subtitle: Branching cooperative fantasy RPG adventure through the magical realm of Rivellon
tagline: Unleash the Source, master the elements, and ascend to Divinity
loreSummary: The Divine is fallen, and the destructive Void threatens the fabric of Rivellon. Stripped of freedom and bound by Magister collars, your party must unleash latent Source powers, forge alliances, and shape the destiny of the world.
keyFeatures: Interactive ring-bound Divine Atlas game book featuring 50 interconnected locations
Deep tactical combat with Action Points and signature elemental surface interactions
Branching narrative system where party choices permanently alter unlocked storylines
Character progression with customizable skill builds, Source powers, and loot upgrades

dos_standard_path.name: Standard Divine Campaign
dos_standard_path.description: The complete narrative journey through Acts 1, 2, and 3 to the final confrontation in the Hall of Echoes (~16 locations).

dos_act1_escape.name: Act 1: Escape from Fort Joy
dos_act1_escape.description: Introductory campaign focusing on escaping the island prison, removing Source collars, and securing freedom (~5 locations).

dos_extended_branches.name: Extended Rivellon Odyssey
dos_extended_branches.description: Expanded campaign experience pursuing hidden secondary locations, character sub-quests, and divergent story paths (~24 locations).

dos_full_atlas.name: Complete Atlas Chronicle
dos_full_atlas.description: Exhaustive exploration navigating alternate branches, legendary encounters, and high-difficulty trials across the Divine Atlas (~36 locations).

milestones.title: The Merryweather Shore
milestones.description: Wash ashore upon the shores of Fort Joy following the shipwreck, gather companions, and slip past Magister patrols.

milestones.title: Shattering the Source Collar
milestones.description: Infiltrate the prison bastion, liberate your latent Source power, and break through the fortress perimeter into the wild.

milestones.title: Sanctuary in the Marshes
milestones.description: Traverse dangerous toxic bogs and uncover forgotten Source shrines and ancient ruins harboring seekers.

milestones.title: Incursion of the Voidwoken
milestones.description: Hold the defensive line against monstrous Void beasts pouring through planar tears and master advanced elemental combos.

milestones.title: Ascension in the Hall of Echoes
milestones.description: Enter the ancestral Hall of Echoes, overcome the ultimate trial, and claim your place as the new Divine of Rivellon.
